properties.title: Flood Advisory issued September 28 at 5:48PM MDT until September 28 at 8:45PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:

rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Dona Ana County in south central New Mexico...
Southeastern Luna County in southwestern New Mexico...

* WHEN...Until 845 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos. Water over
roadways.

- At 548 PM MDT, Thunderstorms with torrential rainfall were moving
into southwestern Dona Ana County. Expect flooding on arroyos and
rural back roads north of Highway 9 in the next couple of hours.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...

Counties, including the area around Mount Riley, Potrillo Ranch,

matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued September 28 at 7:10PM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Straits of Florida from Halfmoon Shoal to 20 nm west of Dry Tortugas
out 60 nm...
Straits of Florida from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to south of
Halfmoon Shoal 20 to 60 nm out...

At 709 PM EDT, National Weather Service meteorologists detected a
large cluster of strong thunderstorms, capable of producing wind
gusts near 30 knots. These thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 35 nm south of Tortugas Ecological Reserve South to
46 nm south of Twenty-Eight Foot Shoal Light, moving northeast at 10
knots.

Strong thunderstorms will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for thunderstorms with wind gusts near 30 knots, locally
rough and confused seas, occasional lightning strikes, and
potentially blinding downpours. Get to a safe port as quickly, and as
safely as possible. When downpours reduce visibility, slow down.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in

Des Plaines River near Gurnee affecting Lake IL County.

Des Plaines River near Russell affecting Lake IL County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Des Plaines River from IL/WI state line downstream to US-41
in Gurnee, including the Russell gauge.

* WHEN...Until Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 8.0 feet, Agricultural and park land is inundated near
the river. Residential property is threatened near the river.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 AM CDT Monday the stage was 7.8 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:30 AM CDT Monday was 8.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Thursday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 7.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 7.8
feet on 06/05/1970.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Warning means water levels above flood stage are imminent or
may already be occurring. Persons along rivers and streams in the
warned area should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.

These forecasts are based almost entirely on observed precipitation
as little to no additional precipitation is currently expected over
the next 24 to 48 hours.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued by this evening.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 28 at 9:13AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor remains within Minor Flood Stage due to
tidal effects. River levels are forecast to gradually subside through
Minor Flood Stage this week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon
Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water
approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and
Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river
water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor
Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are
covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud
roads are underwater with yards inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 AM EDT Monday the stage was 2.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 AM EDT Monday was 2.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 2.6 feet today, and then gradually subside through Minor
Flood Stage this week.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 2.6
feet on 10/14/1996.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
